steps.title: Conventions: A_z=Z[q^{pm},z^{pm}], K_z=Q(q)[z^{pm}], Q=q^2; U commutative toral; Backend A dictionary Ycheck=z1*Y1/Q
Lemma 1(b): B_r(m)=[m r]_Q in Z[Q] (q-Pascal construction)
Lemma 1(c): B_r(-n)=(-1)^r Q^{-nr-binom(r,2)}[n+r-1 r]_Q in Z[Q^{pm1}]
Lemma 2: ev_chi(Ycheck^u nu_r)=Q^{u chi}B_r(chi) in A_z; S subset N^ev
Lemma 3 core: V lower-unitriangular, det 1, V^{-1} over Z[Q^{pm1}]
Lemma 3, z-spectator + base change Z[Q^{pm}]->Z[q^{pm}]->A_z (referee findings 3,4)
Theorem 1 assembly: Laurent clearing by the unit Ycheck^N (referee finding 5)
Clause (i) witness: products of generators stay grid-integral
Clause (i): N^ev = intersection of ev_chi^{-1}(A_z) is an A_z-subalgebra
Clause (ii): U commutative => Z(U^ev)=N^ev, HC=id, W trivial
Clause (iii): N^ev = S (Theorem 1), via grid + forward + reverse + clearing
Attribution: Harman-Hopkins dictionary (tests A/B of hh_dictionary_check.py, now in-ledger)

claims.frame: B_r(m) vs ZZ[X] q-Pascal Gaussian binomial, X=Q
claims.expr:
let
    Bf = (r,m) -> prod([ (Q^m - Q^t)/(Q^r - Q^t) for t in 0:r-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    SX, X = polynomial_ring(ZZ, "X")
    function qbf(m,r)
        (r < 0 || r > m) && return zero(SX)
        r == 0 && return one(SX)
        return qbf(m-1,r-1) + X^r*qbf(m-1,r)
    end
    all( Bf(r,m) == evaluate(qbf(m,r), Q) for r in 0:8 for m in r:10 )
end
claims.note: equality with a ZZ[X]-constructed object certifies membership in Z[Q]

claims.frame: Backend A dictionary: Ycheck = z1*Y1/Q, ev_m is Y1 -> Q^(m+1)/z1
claims.expr:
let
    Bf = (r,m) -> prod([ (Q^m - Q^t)/(Q^r - Q^t) for t in 0:r-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    all( evaluate(nu1(r), [Q^(m+1)/z1, one(Kcoeff)]) == Bf(r,m) for r in 0:5 for m in -4:5 )
end

let
    Bf = (r,m) -> prod([ (Q^m - Q^t)/(Q^r - Q^t) for t in 0:r-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    evF = function(x, m)
        pt = [Q^(m+1)/z1, one(Kcoeff)]
        return evaluate(numerator(x), pt)/evaluate(denominator(x), pt)
    end
    all( evF( FY(z1*Y1/Q)^u * FY(nu1(r)), m ) == Q^(u*m)*Bf(r,m) for u in -2:2 for r in 0:4 for m in -3:4 )
end

claims.frame: values of shifted generators are z-free and lie in Z[q^{pm1}] (subset A_z)
claims.expr:
let
    Bf = (r,m) -> prod([ (Q^m - Q^t)/(Q^r - Q^t) for t in 0:r-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    iszq = function(v; even=false)
        n = numerator(v); d = denominator(v)
        length(d) == 1 || return false
        coeff(d,1) == 1 || return false
        dv = exponent_vector(d,1)
        all(dv[i] == 0 for i in 2:5) || return false
        even && dv[1] % 2 != 0 && return false
        for j in 1:length(n)
            ev = exponent_vector(n,j)
            all(ev[i] == 0 for i in 2:5) || return false
            even && (ev[1] - dv[1]) % 2 != 0 && return false
            denominator(coeff(n,j)) == 1 || return false
        end
        return true
    end
    all( iszq( Q^(u*m)*Bf(r,m) ) for u in -2:2 for r in 0:4 for m in -3:4 )
end

let
    Bf = (r,m) -> prod([ (Q^m - Q^t)/(Q^r - Q^t) for t in 0:r-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    M = matrix(Kcoeff, 9, 9, [ Bf(r,m) for m in 0:8 for r in 0:8 ])
    all( M[i,j] == zero(Kcoeff) for i in 1:9 for j in (i+1):9 ) && all( M[i,i] == one(Kcoeff) for i in 1:9 ) && det(M) == one(Kcoeff)
end

claims.frame: nu_2(Q^{-3}) = Q^{-7}[4 2]_Q, a genuine Laurent value (referee finding 5)

    Bf = (r,m) -> prod([ (Q^m - Q^t)/(Q^r - Q^t) for t in 0:r-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    SX, X = polynomial_ring(ZZ, "X")
    function qbf(m,r)
        (r < 0 || r > m) && return zero(SX)
        r == 0 && return one(SX)
        return qbf(m-1,r-1) + X^r*qbf(m-1,r)
    end
    iszq = function(v; even=false)
        n = numerator(v); d = denominator(v)
        length(d) == 1 || return false
        coeff(d,1) == 1 || return false
        dv = exponent_vector(d,1)

        return true
    end
    Bf(2,-3) == Q^(-7)*evaluate(qbf(4,2), Q) && iszq(Bf(2,-3); even=true)
end

claims.frame: products of shifted generators stay grid-integral (clause-i witness)
claims.expr:
let
    Bf = (r,m) -> prod([ (Q^m - Q^t)/(Q^r - Q^t) for t in 0:r-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    evF = function(x, m)
        pt = [Q^(m+1)/z1, one(Kcoeff)]
        return evaluate(numerator(x), pt)/evaluate(denominator(x), pt)
    end
    iszq = function(v; even=false)
        n = numerator(v); d = denominator(v)
        length(d) == 1 || return false
        coeff(d,1) == 1 || return false
        dv = exponent_vector(d,1)
        all(dv[i] == 0 for i in 2:5) || return false
        even && dv[1] % 2 != 0 && return false
        for j in 1:length(n)
            ev = exponent_vector(n,j)
            all(ev[i] == 0 for i in 2:5) || return false
            even && (ev[1] - dv[1]) % 2 != 0 && return false
            denominator(coeff(n,j)) == 1 || return false
        end
        return true
    end
    gen = (u,r) -> FY(z1*Y1/Q)^u * FY(nu1(r))
    all( iszq( evF( gen(u,r)*gen(v,s), m ) ) for u in -1:1 for v in -1:1 for r in 1:2 for s in 1:2 for m in -2:3 )
end

claims.frame: nu_k(1+(Q-1)x) = HH q-binomial [x k]_Q term-by-term; x = l1 free
claims.expr:
let
    qint = t -> (Q^t - 1)/(Q - 1)
    nuat = k -> prod([ ((1+(Q-1)*l1) - Q^t)/(Q^k - Q^t) for t in 0:k-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    hh = k -> prod([ (l1 - qint(t))/(qint(k) - qint(t)) for t in 0:k-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    all( nuat(k) == hh(k) for k in 0:5 )
end

claims.expr:
let
    Bf = (r,m) -> prod([ (Q^m - Q^t)/(Q^r - Q^t) for t in 0:r-1 ]; init=one(Kcoeff))
    SX, X = polynomial_ring(ZZ, "X")

let

end
